backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing access control, user profiles, and an approval workflow with admin‑gated actions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing approval‑related requirements, affected frontend files, and associated components and tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all major frontend files including auth screens, Firebase wrappers, deployment docs, and UI utilities.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment runbook detailing build steps, approval‑gating verification, troubleshooting, and rollback procedures.
frontend/firestore.rules: Firestore security rules enforcing role‑based and approval‑based access for user documents with strict field protections.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles and OKLCH color variables defining light/dark themes with consistent design tokens.
frontend/index.html: Static HTML entry loading Firebase SDK via CDN, initializing Firebase app/auth/firestore, and mounting the React bundle.
frontend/LIVE_SMOKE_TEST.md: End‑to‑end smoke test checklist covering signup, approval gating, admin behavior, security rules, and console‑log verification.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Controls navigation between login, signup, and password reset screens using local state.
Provides a centered auth page layout with footer branding for authentication screens.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing related queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and utilities for managing Internet Identity authentication and login state.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light/dark theme colors and shared UI styling.
frontend/src/lib/firebase.ts: Wraps Firebase globals loaded via CDN, providing helpers for auth, Firestore operations, and profile creation.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseErrorMessages.t: Maps Firebase error codes to user-friendly error messages.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for user profiles and signup data.
Resizes, compresses, and validates profile images client‑side, producing a processed file and data URL.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/screens/LoginScreen.tsx: Implements the login UI, handling email/password authentication and error display.
frontend/src/screens/PasswordResetScreen: UI-only password reset form that logs the request and shows an admin‑handled reset message after submission, with navigation back to login.
frontend/src/screens/SignupScreen.tsx: Signup flow with form fields, relation selection, phone formatting, profile image upload/camera capture, validation, and Firebase signup handling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash/query state.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, animations, container settings, and enabling typography, container‑queries, and animate plugins.
